rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=125, pretrain_lr=0.0001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=300, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-7 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric) for itnet = ItNet v1 (pretrain-denoiser-then-FIXED-DC, solver_itnet.py). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) PRIOR (val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV; hr=metric of record): iter-1 ep8/tn200 k3 SSIM 0.4413/hr 0.000; iter-2 ep48 0.5927/0; iter-3 ep160 0.6430/0; iter-4 ep220 0.7022/0; iter-5 ep140/tn300 0.6932/0 (all k=3, all hr 0). iter-6 changed itnet_k 3->1 and BROKE THE FLOOR: SSIM 0.9332 / hr 0.3752 (NEW BEST, #3 on Mayo board, above itnet_v3 0.3366), elapsed 1281.4s, params_M 0.2329. The over-applied 3-step FIXED/untrained DC was DEGRADING the recon; 1 DC step + the trained SmallUNet denoiser is the sweet spot. itnet v1 is NOT structurally capped -- k=1 unlocked it. (2) LIMITER (k=1 now fixed, no longer floor-pulling): the trained SmallUNet denoiser (params_M 0.2329, ep200) is now the bottleneck. pretrain_epochs already shows diminishing SSIM returns (iters 1-4 slope) and at ep200 the denoiser is well-converged (0.9332). The strongest UNTRIED axis at k=1 is DATA COVERAGE: itnet loads a FIXED stratified train subset ONCE via load_val_split(n=train_n)+randperm, NO rotation, so train_n=200 sees only ~35%% of the 579-slice pool. The campaign doc CONFIRMS train_n is the live lever that lifted every end-to-end trainer (uswin 200->480 hr +0.0297 NEW champ; itnet_v3 200->400 hr +0.0165) and explicitly names itnet to apply it once epochs plateau; the v1-champion insight records itnet is mildly data-limited (train_n 200->300 lifted 0.97256->0.97294). iter-5 train_n 300 did NOT help but that was at the BROKEN k=3 regime with epochs ALSO dropped, not a clean test at k=1. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 200 -> 300 (+50%% data coverage, +1 ps-group of anatomy at k=1, from BASE_ITER=6). pretrain_epochs 200 -> 125 is the BUDGET BACKSTOP (NOT a 2nd hypothesis-knob) to hold the HARD 20-min wall: iter-6 ALREADY OVERRAN at 1281.4s; grad steps 300x125=37500 are -6.25%% vs iter-6 200x200=40000, so the change isolates DATA COVERAGE from extra optimization while reducing total work. KEEP itnet_k=1 (the breakthrough). All else identical to iter-6 (itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, pretrain_lr=1e-4, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: broader data coverage lifts hr ABOVE 0.3752 (predict ~0.385-0.40, tracking the +0.016-to-+0.030 train_n gains the sibling end-to-end trainers got). FALSIFIER (operative, NUMERIC): if hr <= 0.3752 at train_n=300/k=1, the data-coverage lever is EXHAUSTED for v1 at k=1 (denoiser is FBP-information-bounded, not data-limited) -> document and the next lever is a different axis (capacity/alpha). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score; sbatch 30-min wall is the only hard fence): from iter-6 (1281s @ ep200/tn200) fixed~185s, per_epoch(200)=5.48s -> per_epoch(300)=8.22s; ep125 @ tn300 -> 185 + 125*8.22 = 1213s ~20.2 min, AT the HARD line but BELOW iter-6 1281s and well under the 30-min fence (sized DELIBERATELY conservative: doc warns itnet has overrun; ep130 would predict 1254s, tighter, so 125 is the safe decisive probe). val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default; NO fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside the DC step overflows otherwise). v1 has NO max_train_s backstop. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each val slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, KEEP itnet_k=1, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override).
